facts.activity_file: assessing and permitting hot work adjacent to live plant

control_failures.control_label: integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: electrical release during transfer operations on TX-3002

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control HAZARDOUS_AREA_EQUIPMENT_INTEGRITY: the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas was never verified as effective, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control SEAL_FACE_TEMPERATURE_ALARM: the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip was never verified as effective, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next critical control verification that the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas on TX-3002 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in authorising hot work, specifically assessing and permitting hot work adjacent to live plant. TX-3002 (switchgear and transformers) is in service for plant HV/LV distribution. The task proceeded during transfer operations while the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas was never verified as effective. The electrical energy involved is held as HV switchgear, and the recorded presentation was shock, arc flash, unplanned energisation.
response.summary: On 13 October 2018 an incident occurred on TX-3002 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during transfer operations, releasing electrical energy held as HV switchgear.
